AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.

5. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

9. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.

10. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.

11. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

12. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

13. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.

14. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
